# Data and code availability

**Code.** All analysis code is in this repository under the **MIT Licence** (`LICENSE`). Nothing is
withheld: every method, every experiment and every verification script is included.

**Birmingham data.** The processed Birmingham feature tables are derived from the *Parking
Birmingham* dataset (Birmingham City Council, via the UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 482,
CC BY 4.0). They are included in full and shared under the **same CC BY 4.0** terms, with the
attribution the source licence requires.

**Belgrade data.** **Not redistributed.** The records were obtained from JKP Parking servis Beograd
and we hold no documented authority to redistribute them. A formal permission request is outstanding.
In their place this repository provides the acquisition route, the full column schema and the
**SHA-256 of every withheld file**, so that a replicator who obtains the data can prove they hold the
exact file the article used. See `01_data/processed/BELGRADE-DATA.md`. All Belgrade **results** are
included in `05_results/reference/`.

**Consequence, stated plainly.** Independent third-party end-to-end reproduction is demonstrable on
**Birmingham**. For **Belgrade** we can demonstrate deterministic reproduction and hash-level
identity, but not third-party reproduction, until redistribution permission is granted.

**Licences are file-level and are not interchangeable.** This repository must not be redeposited
anywhere under a single blanket licence: doing so would relicense the Birmingham-derived files, whose
source licence requires attribution and which we cannot waive.
